decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).
Condition : 3 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - Before first occupation of the buildings the loading, unloading and turning space, and parking spaces (including spaces for people with disabilities) shall be provided within the curtilage of the site in accordance with the scheme shown on drawing No. 0009.1.107 and such spaces shall be permanently available and not be used for any other purpose.

Condition : 5 - Prior to the proposed retail use being implement the ecisting retail use in the adjoining premises (outlined blue on application site plan) shall cease and no part of the adjoining premises shall be used for retail purposes for so long as the application premises are used for retail purposes.
description: Refurbishment of warehouse and change of use to retail unit with basement showroom.
